bugs.title: Google Play Console: 16 KB page size alignment not supported
bugs.root_cause: Missing android.mPageSize64K=true flag in gradle.properties; Firebase 21.1.0 doesn't include 16 KB optimizations
changes: Enabled R8 minification and resource shrinking in release buildType
Created comprehensive proguard-rules.pro with keep rules for Firebase, Pusher, ML Kit, Google Play Services
recommendations: Upload AAB to Google Play Console

bugs.error_message: Backtick in markdown code span was interpreted as a PowerShell escape, inserting a backspace in CLAUDE.md.
bugs.root_cause: PowerShell double-quoted string interpolation interpreted the markdown opening backtick followed by b as a backspace escape.
bugs.fix: Replaced the backspace with a literal markdown code-span backtick and verified the resulting diff.
